title: Telehealth in specialized palliative home care for adults
summary: Further development, implementation and validation of telemedicine for specialized palliative home care for adults

interventions.name: Application observation for supplementing the standard care of specialized outpatient palliative care for adults with telemedicine

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Healthcare professionals (doctors and nurses) as well as other professional groups, such as social service staff, administrative staff and pastoral care workers; Fluency in written and spoken German; Performing activities that are typical for the area under review; Work in direct patient care or administration and Use of the PalliDoc mobile app
Exclusion criteria:
None
